display_name: 交叉半窗自监督 DURA GPU 训练
description: 固定源域 DURA，独立初始化多尺度修正和辅助编码器；同记录前后半窗交叉自监督，仅用源 IQ 训练，最终版本执行七景冻结测试。

data.representation: paired received/clean IQ, per-packet DURA and its estimated physical action

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only DURA v1.0; fresh zero-head multiscale correction and fresh patch encoder independently initialized; no trained auxiliary encoder inherited
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA provenance checked by frozen_dura; deterministic source context cache uses matching ordered 8192 fit IDs and source-only data contract
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: DURA is source-only with matching data contract and no target ancestry; correction and auxiliary encoder independently initialized
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5; no source or target performance selection

rows.method: Fresh multiscale DURA correction with jointly trained source IQ cross-half encoder and 0.05 same-half feature loss
rows.purpose: Train a distinct F-free recovery network at fixed five-epoch budget
rows.seed_notes: Correction seed 2026110612, source fit 2026110611, order 2026110613, fresh patch encoder seed 2026110615; DURA seed 2026092701.

notes: Cross-half source SSL pairs the received first 128 samples with clean second 128 samples of the same record, and vice versa; off-diagonal weight 0.01.
Fresh encoder updates first; frozen encoder then supplies 0.05 same-half restored-versus-clean feature loss to the correction network alongside source IQ and DURA guard losses.
No TX labels, F, V or target are used in G or encoder training; auxiliary encoder is not used during ground inference.
8192 source IDs, 3 fixed simulated views, five epochs, AdamW learning rate 0.0003 weight decay 0.001 for both networks; cached source context and deterministic GPU.
Freeze final epoch without source or target performance selection; all 168000 records in all seven Phase1 views are predicted before independent truth-last scoring with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.
Auxiliary features may capture packet content or receiver rather than identity; source IQ quality alone does not establish ground recognition gains.
